_: AI crawlers and retrieval agents that get the Markdown version of a page at the page's own URL. Matched as case-insensitive substrings of the User-Agent. `never` wins over everything at a page's URL, including an explicit Accept: text/markdown: serving a search crawler different content from what people see at the same URL is cloaking, so Googlebot and Bingbot must never be added to `agents`. A .md URL is a different address that returns the same Markdown to everyone, crawlers included, marked noindex with the HTML page as canonical.
_contentSignal: Content-Signal header sent on every Markdown response (contentsignals.org): how the content may be used once fetched. This is a content-usage policy, not a technical setting. The value is the one cosmonic.com uses ('allow all'), and the one Cloudflare's Markdown for Agents adds by default to pages it converts itself. Change it here and nowhere else. Empty string sends no header.
